name: Unified Metric Aggregation
aliases: Evaluation Reporting, Global and Per-view Metric Aggregation
definition: Aggregates per-view PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS scores into global averages and per-view dictionaries for evaluation reporting.
summary: Unified Metric Aggregation standardizes quantitative performance reports by orchestrating multiple metric types, normalizing data, and generating structured outputs for consistent comparison.
